records.note: First same-GPU comparison against a current PyTorch operator. The average pool finished about 4.6 times sooner. Temperatures matched within a degree. Power samples include an nvidia-smi query between launches.
On this synthetic series the moving average was more accurate, and the paired calculation matched the median.
Deployable dual-mode path versus single-mode Wiener under the locked Phase 3 model. Algebra matches plain MMSE. This is the quality win Phase 4 carries forward.
